Sales Manager - Minnesota

Apply now

Job Description:

The Sales Manager's primary role is to implement and execute the company’s strategy to optimize sales growth and develop the distribution channels of the Wacker Neuson full line of equipment in a specific geographical area involving significant travel.

This position is focused on Minnesota, North Dakota, South Dakota and part of Wisconsin Markets, for Wacker Neuson. The Sales Manager must live within Minneapolis, MN area.

This position is the key point of contact for our customers and is responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with dealers and strategic accounts. Sales Managers formulate and implement business strategies to develop all pillars of distribution, including individual account plans to grow overall sales revenue and market share with contracted, strategic, and retail accounts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Sales Activities:

  • Lead the development and execution of sales business plan.
  • Manage and lead the development of all pillars of distribution within their assigned territory to meet their goals and objectives.
  • Prospect new distribution across all pillars of distribution to optimize the districts performance as well as balance out portfolio’s market penetration.
  • Identify deficiencies in all areas of distribution creating a plan and market campaign to address those deficiencies efficiently using all of the resources available.
  • Participate in local and national trade shows.
  • Develops a working knowledge of the competition and their ongoing sales strategies.
Financial:
  • Provide financial guidance where needed to assist our distributions position in their market.
  • Develop equipment quotes and provide financial programs offered.
  • Develops, deploys, and maintains programs (pricing, terms and conditions, non-disclosure agreements, customer incentive/rebate programs).
Other:
  • Work with product managers and engineering on product development and enhancement (i.e. Voice of Customer).
  • Maintains current knowledge on all Wacker Neuson Product lines (taking online training modules, attending classes at the VTC Training center, etc).
  • Maintains customer satisfaction by investigating concerns, implementing corrective action, and communicating with customers and sales team as needed.
Safety:
  • Performs all job functions is a safe manner and maintains safety awareness whether on Wacker Neuson Equipment or within the Corporate Fleet Vehicle.
  • Reports known accidents, injuries and unsafe practices and/or conditions to supervisor at first given opportunity.

Required Skills:

Qualifications: Additional years of experience or education may be substituted for each other as determined by Human Resources.

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Sales Management, Marketing or similar program is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in a sales role.
  • Flexibility to work outside normal work hours, as required. (Saturday open houses, trade shows)
  • Knowledge of Wacker Neuson equipment, its applications and markets are preferred.
  • A basic understanding of competitive equipment and competitor’s market tactics is required.
  • Strong business acumen in terms of understanding of business concept and marketplace functions of Distribution Dealers, Rental Dealers and End Users in the construction industry.
  • Excellent communication skills in the area of communicating well formulated value propositions that competently combines our company strategy aligning our offering with distributions goals both economic and product centric.
  • Excellent verbal, written and public speaking skills.
  • Strong conflict resolution and problem solving skills.
  • Proficient computer skills including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time.
  • Valid Driver’s License
